roles: Product appearance references; unseen views illustrative
prompt: Create ONE high resolution photographic shooting guide contact sheet, 2 columns by 4 rows, eight numbered panels. Reference the three supplied photos of the same actual white turf football shoe with red sole, red collar, white laces, gold red-outlined arrow graphics. This is an instructional angle guide for a beginner, NOT advertising. Plain pale gray tabletop and background, soft even light, sharp entire shoe, large shoe in each panel, simple repeatable poses with ONE shoe per panel. Distinguish the two different sides seen in references: large long gold arrow side vs small rear gold arrow side; do not mirror one to fake the other. Unseen geometry is only schematic reference. Panel 1: full orthogonal side profile showing large long gold arrow, camera at shoe height. Panel 2: opposite full orthogonal side profile showing small rear gold arrow. Panel 3: straight front toe view camera slightly elevated, show toe width and laces. Panel 4: straight rear heel view camera at heel height. Panel 5: true overhead entire shoe heel to toe with margins, not cropped. Panel 6: shoe laid sideways sole turned square to camera, entire red turf outsole with margins. Panel 7: closeup toe and large arrow side surface, seam to red outsole visible. Panel 8: closeup tongue white laces red padded collar and opening from above. Every panel has large clear number 01 to 08 and short English label respectively OUTER SIDE, INNER SIDE, FRONT, HEEL, TOP, SOLE, TOE DETAIL, TONGUE & COLLAR. Clean understated typography. Title SHOOTING GUIDE - 8 VIEWS. Footer POSE REFERENCE ONLY - VERIFY DETAILS ON REAL SHOE. No decorative props, no floating footwear, no extra shoes, no invented advertising text. Preserve actual reference silhouette and color arrangement as closely as possible.
limitations: Guide only. Generated lettering, texture and outsole layout differ from actual photos. Side labels describe reference views, not verified catalog anatomy.
